text: Melanie, you have $110,000 but the plan says you would need up to $1,200,000, a shortfall of $490,000. Timothy has $140,000 against recommended coverage, leaving a $610,000 gap. With Liam (6) and Josh (3) and two incomes of $150,000 and $120,000, losing either income would be hard for the household to absorb.
